maya: Quick heads-up — finalizing release notes for today's deploy (window 17:00-18:00 PT). Draft below; need compact copy for staff blast and a one-liner for the deploybot. Can someone confirm rollback criteria and canary cadence? /cc @nina @tom

tom: On it. Can confirm canary at 10% for 15m, then 50% for 10m if no errors. Rollback if error-rate >0.5% or latency p95 regresses >200ms.

sara: I'll shorten the notes. Can we add a sentence re: model pinning? We pinned model: rwd-model-v2.1 for hosted.

maya: Yes — add: 'Pinned rwd-model-v2.1 for consistency; auto-fallback to v2.0 on failure.' Keep it tight.

nina: Ok. One-liner suggestion for deploybot: 'Deploy v1.12.0: kv-cache perf + quant-fix. Canary 10%->50%. Pin rwd-model-v2.1; rollback on >0.5% errors.'

liam: Oncall: add the rollback command: `deploybot rollback release v1.12.0 --force` and note that ops will trigger. Also tag infra: @tom.

tom: Got it. Also reminder: blackout window 18:00-19:00 PT in case rollback needed.

maya: Here's the compact RN (please only edit lines for bullets):

```
- Performance: Improved KV cache eviction for 2–3x tail-latency reduction on long sequences.
- Fix: Quantization path bug causing tokenization misalignment in edge cases.
- Ops: Pinned model rwd-model-v2.1; canary rollout 10% for 15m -> 50% for 10m -> full.
- Rollback: If error rate >0.5% or p95 latency +200ms, ops will invoke: `deploybot rollback release v1.12.0 --force`.
```

Please confirm ASAP.

sara: :thumbsup: editing now, will post compressed blast copy.

deploybot: deploybot: scheduled deploy v1.12.0 at 2026-03-21T17:00:00Z. Status: queued. Canary policy: 10% -> 50% -> full. Note: to abort: `deploybot abort 7365432100`.

nina: Confirming. Maya, I'm happy with the canary/rollback language. Sara — once you post internal blast, pin me in case of last-minute changes.

liam: Oncall will watch metrics. I'll post a single-line slack alert if we hit thresholds.

maya: Thanks team. Sara: please post the internal blast 10 minutes before deploy. Tom: keep infra on standby. I'll update the release notes doc with this compact copy.
